data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'K-D-SH', meaning 'to rule' or 'to be a king'. In Islamic context, Kadshah symbolizes the ultimate sovereignty of Allah. The name Kadshah carries the meaning “Ruler, King, Sovereign” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Kadshah usually hope their child will grow to embody ruler, king, sovereign and live with faith, good character and purpose.
